about: The public Gian's Picks page. A pick with "draft": true is hidden from visitors; open the page with #preview at the end of the address to see drafts. 'watch' links a pick to a Gear Watch item so it shows today's best price.
title: Gian's Picks
intro: What I tell friends when they ask what to buy.

picks.name: MacBook Neo
picks.goodFor: Students, email and web, and anyone who wants a real Mac without spending a thousand dollars.
picks.why: Aluminum build, a sharp 13-inch screen and up to 16 hours of battery, for less than any MacBook before it.
picks.skipIf: You edit video or keep a lot of apps open. It tops out at 8GB of memory.

picks.name: 14-inch MacBook Pro (M6)
picks.goodFor: Video editing, coding and heavier work that would bog down a MacBook Neo.
picks.why: The newest base Pro, and the one most people who need a Pro should look at first.
picks.skipIf: Your day is mostly browser tabs and documents. That's MacBook Neo territory.

picks.name: iPad mini (OLED)
picks.goodFor: Reading, notes and travel, when a phone is too small and a laptop is too much.
picks.why: The new 8.5-inch OLED screen and A20 Pro chip, and it's the first iPad that's water resistant.
picks.skipIf: You want a laptop replacement with a keyboard. Get a bigger iPad or a MacBook.

picks.name: Mac mini (M6)
picks.goodFor: A desk setup where you already have a monitor, keyboard and mouse.
picks.why: 16GB of memory, Wi-Fi 7 and up to three displays in a box that fits in your hand.
picks.skipIf: You need to work from the couch. On a tight budget, watch for a refurbished M4 instead.

picks.name: Five Bars
picks.goodFor: Picking a phone plan or chasing a free-phone deal.
picks.why: My tracker that compares plans and phone deals from the big three carriers and smaller carriers like Visible, Mint and US Mobile.
